# CampusWorks - Complete Implementation Documentation

## 🎯 **Project Overview**

CampusWorks is a **peer-to-peer academic record outsourcing platform** where students can pay other students to complete their academic records and assignments through a competitive bidding system.

### **Core Workflow:**
1. **Requester** (STUDENT) posts a record-writing task with budget
2. **Workers** (WORKER) bid competitively within time window
3. **Lowest bidder** automatically wins after auction ends
4. **Worker** completes record **offline**
5. **Worker** updates status in application
6. **Requester** verifies **offline** and confirms completion
7. **Payment** processed via UPI gateway

---

## 🏗️ **Architecture Overview**

### **Microservices Architecture:**
- **`eureka-server`** (8761) → Service Discovery
- **`api-gateway`** (8080) → JWT Authentication, Routing
- **`auth-service`** (8081) → User Management, JWT Generation
- **`profile-service`** (8082) → User Profiles, Ratings
- **`task-service`** (8084) → Task Management, Lifecycle
- **`bidding-service`** (8083) → Bidding System, Auctions
- **`payment-service`** (8085) → UPI Integration 
- **`notification-service`** (8086) → Email/SMS 

### **Technology Stack:**
- **Spring Boot 3.2.5** + **Spring Cloud 2024.0.1**
- **MySQL** (Primary Database)
- **JWT** (Authentication)
- **OpenFeign** (Inter-service Communication)
- **Eureka** (Service Discovery)
- **Spring Cloud Gateway** (API Gateway)

---

## 🔧 **Service Implementation Details**

### **1. Enhanced Auth Service (Port: 8081)**

#### **What I Implemented:**
- **CampusWorks-specific user registration** with STUDENT/WORKER roles
- **Enhanced User entity** with department, phone, timestamps
- **JWT-based authentication** with role-based access
- **User management endpoints** for other services

#### **API Endpoints:**
```http
POST /auth/register
{
  "email": "student@example.com",
  "password": "password123",
  "fullName": "John Doe",
  "department": "Computer Science",
  "phone": "+1234567890",
  "userType": "STUDENT"
}

POST /auth/login
{
  "email": "student@example.com",
  "password": "password123"
}

GET /auth/user/{email}
GET /auth/user/id/{userId}
```

#### **Database Schema:**
```sql
users (id, email, password, full_name, department, phone, created_at, updated_at)
user_roles (user_id, role) -- Many-to-many relationship
```

#### **JWT & Gateway Integration:**
- **JWT tokens** generated on login/register
- **API Gateway** validates JWT and adds `X-User-Name` header
- **Role-based access** (STUDENT, WORKER, ADMIN)

#### **Example Log Output:**
```
2024-01-15 10:30:15.123 INFO  [auth-service] Processing CampusWorks registration request for email: student@example.com with userType: STUDENT
2024-01-15 10:30:15.456 INFO  [auth-service] CampusWorks user registered successfully - ID: 1, Email: student@example.com, Type: STUDENT, Department: Computer Science
2024-01-15 10:30:15.789 DEBUG [auth-service] JWT token generated for new CampusWorks user: student@example.com
```

---

### **2. Bidding Service (Port: 8083)**

#### **What I Implemented:**
- **Complete bidding system** with auction management
- **Automatic winner selection** (lowest bidder)
- **Scheduled auction processing** (every minute)
- **Inter-service communication** with Task and Auth services
- **Bid validation** and status management

#### **API Endpoints:**
```http
POST /bids/place
{
  "taskId": 1,
  "amount": 50.00
}

GET /bids/task/{taskId}
GET /bids/bidder/{bidderId}
POST /bids/auction/create?taskId=1&endTime=2024-01-16T10:00:00
GET /bids/auction/{taskId}
```

#### **Database Schema:**
```sql
bids (id, task_id, bidder_id, amount, status, created_at, updated_at)
auctions (id, task_id, start_time, end_time, status, winner_id, winning_bid_id, created_at, updated_at)
```

#### **Key Features:**
- **Bid Status Management**: ACTIVE, WON, LOST, WITHDRAWN, EXPIRED
- **Auction Status Management**: ACTIVE, ENDED, CANCELLED, COMPLETED
- **Automatic Winner Selection**: Scheduled task runs every minute
- **Inter-service Communication**: Feign clients for Task and Auth services

#### **Example Log Output:**
```
2024-01-15 10:35:20.123 INFO  [bidding-service] Processing bid request - Task: 1, Amount: 50.00, Bidder: worker@example.com
2024-01-15 10:35:20.456 INFO  [bidding-service] Bid placed successfully - Bid ID: 1, Task: 1, Amount: 50.00, Bidder: worker@example.com
2024-01-15 10:36:00.789 DEBUG [bidding-service] Processing ended auctions...
2024-01-15 10:36:01.012 INFO  [bidding-service] Auction ended - Task: 1, Winner: 2, Amount: 45.00
```

---

### **3. Enhanced Task Service (Port: 8084)**

#### **What I Implemented:**
- **Complete task lifecycle management** with status tracking
- **CampusWorks-specific task model** with budget, categories, deadlines
- **Task assignment** from bidding service
- **Status updates** for workers and requesters
- **Task filtering** by status, requester, worker

#### **API Endpoints:**
```http
POST /tasks
{
  "title": "Complete Data Structures Lab Record",
  "description": "Need help with implementing binary search tree algorithms",
  "budget": 100.00,
  "category": "Programming",
  "deadline": "2024-01-20T23:59:59"
}

GET /tasks
GET /tasks/{id}
GET /tasks/status/{status}
GET /tasks/requester/{requesterId}
GET /tasks/worker/{workerId}
PUT /tasks/{id}/assign?workerId=2
PUT /tasks/{id}/status?status=COMPLETED
```

#### **Database Schema:**
```sql
tasks (id, title, description, budget, category, posted_by, assigned_to, status, deadline, completed_at, created_at, updated_at)
```

#### **Task Status Flow:**
```
POSTED → BIDDING → ASSIGNED → IN_PROGRESS → COMPLETED → VERIFIED → PAID
```

#### **Example Log Output:**
```
2024-01-15 10:40:15.123 INFO  [task-service] Creating new CampusWorks task - Title: Complete Data Structures Lab Record, Budget: 100.00, Requester: student@example.com
2024-01-15 10:40:15.456 INFO  [task-service] CampusWorks task created successfully - ID: 1, Title: Complete Data Structures Lab Record, Requester: student@example.com
2024-01-15 10:45:20.789 INFO  [task-service] Assigning CampusWorks task 1 to worker 2
2024-01-15 10:45:21.012 INFO  [task-service] CampusWorks task 1 assigned to worker 2
```

---

## 🔄 **Inter-Service Communication**

### **OpenFeign Clients:**

#### **Bidding Service → Task Service:**
```java
@FeignClient(name = "task-service")
public interface TaskServiceClient {
    @GetMapping("/tasks/{taskId}")
    ApiResponse<Object> getTask(@PathVariable Long taskId);
    
    @PutMapping("/tasks/{taskId}/assign")
    ApiResponse<String> assignTask(@PathVariable Long taskId, @RequestParam Long workerId);
}
```

#### **Bidding Service → Auth Service:**
```java
@FeignClient(name = "auth-service")
public interface AuthServiceClient {
    @GetMapping("/auth/user/{email}")
    ApiResponse<Object> getUserByEmail(@PathVariable String email);
}
```

#### **Task Service → Profile Service:**
```java
@FeignClient(name = "profile-service")
public interface ProfileServiceClient {
    @GetMapping("/profiles/{userId}")
    ApiResponse<ProfileResponse> getProfileById(@PathVariable Long userId);
}
```

---

## 🔐 **Security & Authentication**

### **JWT Flow:**
1. **User registers/logs in** → Auth Service generates JWT
2. **API Gateway** validates JWT for all requests
3. **Gateway adds** `X-User-Name` header with user email
4. **Downstream services** use header for user identification

### **API Gateway Configuration:**
```properties
# JWT Configuration
security.jwt.secret=CHANGE_ME_SECRET_KEY_FOR_PRODUCTION_USE_AT_LEAST_256_BITS
security.jwt.expiration=86400000

# Routes
spring.cloud.gateway.routes[0].id=auth-service
spring.cloud.gateway.routes[0].uri=lb://auth-service
spring.cloud.gateway.routes[0].predicates[0]=Path=/auth/**

spring.cloud.gateway.routes[4].id=bidding-service
spring.cloud.gateway.routes[4].uri=lb://bidding-service
spring.cloud.gateway.routes[4].predicates[0]=Path=/bids/**
```

---

## 📊 **Database Design**

### **MySQL Tables:**

#### **Auth Service:**
```sql
users (id, email, password, full_name, department, phone, created_at, updated_at)
user_roles (user_id, role)
```

#### **Task Service:**
```sql
tasks (id, title, description, budget, category, posted_by, assigned_to, status, deadline, completed_at, created_at, updated_at)
```

#### **Bidding Service:**
```sql
bids (id, task_id, bidder_id, amount, status, created_at, updated_at)
auctions (id, task_id, start_time, end_time, status, winner_id, winning_bid_id, created_at, updated_at)
```

#### **Profile Service:**
```sql
profiles (id, user_id, full_name, department, bio, created_at, updated_at)
```

---

## 🚀 **Complete Workflow Example**

### **1. User Registration:**
```bash
# Register as STUDENT
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/auth/register \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "email": "student@example.com",
    "password": "password123",
    "fullName": "John Student",
    "department": "Computer Science",
    "phone": "+1234567890",
    "userType": "STUDENT"
  }'

# Register as WORKER
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/auth/register \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "email": "worker@example.com",
    "password": "password123",
    "fullName": "Jane Worker",
    "department": "Computer Science",
    "phone": "+1234567891",
    "userType": "WORKER"
  }'
```

### **2. Task Creation:**
```bash
# Login and get JWT token
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/auth/login \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "email": "student@example.com",
    "password": "password123"
  }'

# Create task (use JWT token from login)
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/tasks \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <JWT_TOKEN>" \
  -d '{
    "title": "Complete Data Structures Lab Record",
    "description": "Need help with implementing binary search tree algorithms",
    "budget": 100.00,
    "category": "Programming",
    "deadline": "2024-01-20T23:59:59"
  }'
```

### **3. Bidding Process:**
```bash
# Place bid (use JWT token)
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/bids/place \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <JWT_TOKEN>" \
  -d '{
    "taskId": 1,
    "amount": 50.00
  }'

# Get bids for task
curl -X GET http://localhost:8080/bids/task/1 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <JWT_TOKEN>"
```

### **4. Task Assignment (Automatic):**
- **Scheduled task** runs every minute
- **Lowest bidder** automatically wins
- **Task status** updated to ASSIGNED
- **Worker notified** of assignment

### **5. Task Completion:**
```bash
# Worker updates status to COMPLETED
curl -X PUT http://localhost:8080/tasks/1/status?status=COMPLETED \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <JWT_TOKEN>"

# Requester confirms completion
curl -X PUT http://localhost:8080/tasks/1/status?status=VERIFIED \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <JWT_TOKEN>"
```

---

## 📝 **Logging & Monitoring**

### **Structured Logging:**
- **Service identification** in all log messages
- **Request tracking** with user context
- **Error handling** with detailed stack traces
- **Performance monitoring** with timing information

### **Log Levels:**
- **DEBUG**: Detailed flow information
- **INFO**: Business operations
- **WARN**: Potential issues
- **ERROR**: System failures

### **Example Log Flow:**
```
[API Gateway] JWT validation successful for user: student@example.com
[Task Service] Creating new CampusWorks task - Title: Lab Record, Budget: 100.00, Requester: student@example.com
[Task Service] CampusWorks task created successfully - ID: 1, Title: Lab Record, Requester: student@example.com
[Bidding Service] Processing bid request - Task: 1, Amount: 50.00, Bidder: worker@example.com
[Bidding Service] Bid placed successfully - Bid ID: 1, Task: 1, Amount: 50.00, Bidder: worker@example.com
```

---

## 🔧 **Configuration & Deployment**

### **Environment Variables:**
```properties
# Database
spring.datasource.url=jdbc:mysql://localhost:3306/campusworks_<service>?createDatabaseIfNotExist=true
spring.datasource.username=root
spring.datasource.password=root

# JWT
jwt.secret=campusworks-secret-key-2024
jwt.expiration=86400000

# Eureka
eureka.client.service-url.defaultZone=http://localhost:8761/eureka/
```

### **Service Ports:**
- **Eureka Server**: 8761
- **API Gateway**: 8080
- **Auth Service**: 8081
- **Profile Service**: 8082
- **Bidding Service**: 8083
- **Task Service**: 8084

---

## 🎯 **Next Steps & Future Enhancements**

### **Immediate Next Steps:**
1. **Payment Service Implementation** (UPI integration)
2. **Notification Service** (Email/SMS alerts)
3. **Profile Service Enhancement** (Ratings, reviews)
4. **Frontend Development** (React application)

### **Future Enhancements:**
1. **Real-time Chat** (WebSocket integration)
2. **File Upload** (Work submission)
3. **Advanced Analytics** (Performance metrics)
4. **Mobile Application** (React Native)

---
